writeup: TIC 232421797 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 6.1926 days. Light from the system dims by 1.33 percent during the primary eclipse, while no secondary eclipse was detected. The automated TESS photometry pipeline identified this candidate with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 134.5 using the Box Least Squares method. Pixel-level image analysis provided additional support, yielding a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 7.8, though the centroid offset measured 9.8 arcseconds from the target location. The candidate does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs examined, making it a novel find. The machine learning screening assigned this target a score of 0.42 on a scale from 0 to 1, indicating moderate confidence. This candidate passed all data quality checks without flagged issues.
